book.title: Mark Riwana Ahiahina Mark i girugirumiya

content: Dowa tapuna da tapuna ana aꞌwanai.

Yesu ivi∼haraharamanihi au wagaYesu, viharaharamana ivi karena meyei Galili topana au gerahana. Ma rava maghamaghauhi hi neꞌi da hita rau-tanighanei. Patara i magha guratana, aubaina tauna au waga i geru, i tughura ma waga hivo dudu-hopuneꞌi au topa ma patara au geraha hi maꞌae.
Ghoha maghamaghauhi awanaꞌineꞌi ivi haraharamanihi.
Tauna awanaꞌineꞌi i riwehi ipa, “Ona rau-tanighana! Tauvao ana vaovao i ghohai ma pehi i ravi-hawari.
Pehi ghehauhi au eta hi peꞌu ma kiu i neꞌi da i anihi.
Ma pehi ghehauhi dowa au vighaꞌighaꞌimana hi peꞌu mepa dowa i habuhaburuyana ma mara tagogi hi gogo.
Ma marainana madegha i rararana, mara tagogi tauhi he poꞌipoꞌi, weꞌi aubaina waramihi egha hita rui guratana dowa au horana.
Pehi ghehauhi dowa au modumoduna ma vividonadonana i ravihawari. Pehihi hi gogo ma donadona i yavanihi da egha hita rau-ano.
Ma pehi ghehauhi dowa au ahiꞌahina i ravi-hauwarihi ma hi gogo kauwa ma hi rau-ano da ghehauhi 30, ghehauhi 60 ma ghehauhi 100.”
Yesu i riwa ipa, “Tanighami, ina maꞌamaꞌae yamna ona rau-tanighana.”
Aiwaꞌi aubaina Yesu awanaꞌinei e dedede.
Maranaina Yesu tau avana i maꞌamaꞌae, ana tauvotaghotagho ma rava ghehauhi hi neꞌi da hivi baghai da awanaina dededena anona itavi heghehi.
Ma Yesu i pari-beyehi ipa, “God ana vibadana dededena, taumi marina avivi heghemi. Ma rava au uputa maemaehi, nonora maghamaghauhi awanaꞌinei he nononora.
Yamna aubaina:

content.text: ‘Tauhi he inainana ma he inainana ma egha hita inainanaꞌi.
Tauhi he rau-rautanighana ma he rau-rautanighana ma egha hita haraharamanei.
Tauhi hita inanaꞌi ma hita haramaneꞌi, apo hita amvereyana meyehi God awarina ma tauna ahi ghohaꞌapoapoe ita nota-tawanei.’” (Isa 6:9-10)

content: Yesu doa tapuna da tapuna ana awanaina ivi heghai
Yesu i rau-bayadehi, “Moina, weꞌi awanaꞌinana egha ota haramanei? Awanaina ghehauhi apo me ona haramanei?
Tauvao, God riwana e pahepahewi.
Rava ghehauhi yana me etanai ma pehi au tepahi e raviravihauwarihi. Riwa he nonori, wate Satan e tamatamavivirihi.
Rava ghehauhi horahi, yana we nanaꞌarena, tauvao dowa au vikirakirana pehi e raviravihawari. Marainana riwa he nononori, yamna riwana he teretereriyei ma hevivi nuwaꞌahiahi.
Tagogi naꞌi riwana egha au horahi ita maemae-nonowa. Marainana rava vivitumaghanaeghahi he rau-iviꞌapoapoeyehi, yamna yaghiyaghina ava he deghadegha.
Rava ghehauhi horahi, yamna me pehi, modu au vidonadonahi he raviravihauwarihi. Tauhi riwa he nonori,
wate weꞌi dobuna ana yawahana nuwaboyana, ana viguyau morumoruna ma ana raughoghara maghamaghauhi riwana evivi tapiai da egha ita raurauano.
Wate rava ghehauhi horahi, yamna me pehi, dowa au ahiꞌahina he raviravihauwarihi. Tauhi yamna, riwa he nonori ma he vaivaini da he raurauano: ghehauhi 30, ghehauhi 60 ma ghehauhi 100.”
Yesu i am dabi ipa, “Aiyaꞌi ravana, rampa e ruiruiyei da au gabaꞌura bo au rauraugovaghana e tereterei? Eꞌegha da ana au anitake evivi hanai.
Aiwaꞌi riwana rauraugovaghana, yamna ina rau-gheꞌegheꞌetei ma aiwaꞌi riwana humahumana, yamna ina wana-tawatawanei.
Ina pa ona rau-tanighana vaimahi, yamna ona nota tuhaghai.”
Tauna maiteni i riwehi, ipa, “Aiwaꞌi o nononoriya, ona nota-vaimahiei. Am nota-vaimaiha ruvanei inavi kahaim ma ina rau-tepani.
Tauhi aiwaꞌi auwarihi, yamna ghehauhi ina rau-tepani. Ma tauhi egha aiwaꞌi auwarihi, yamna aiwaꞌi haburuna hi vaivainiya ina vaina-tawanana pahiyei.”
Pehi me e gogogoneꞌi ana awanaina
Yesu i amdabi ipa, “Weꞌi dededena, yamna God ana vibadana ghohana inanana, me nanaꞌarena. Oroto, witi pehina ana au vaovao i pahewi.
Tauna waguvara eꞌenoeno ma madeghai ana ghohaghohana ghehauhi e ghohaghohahi ma ana pehina yamna mara nonowa e gogogo. Tauna egha ita haramanei me pehina e gogogonei.
Tano tau avana e ghohai da e gogogo ma anona e tereterei. Au naona e rau-pairei, muriyai borina e teretereꞌi. Anina ma e roverove da e rau-ano.
Marainana anona e magumagura, yamna oroto e amꞌam-tuꞌaruta.”
Gaga porana awanaina
Yesu i rau-bayada, “God ana vibadana inanana me nanaꞌarena? Aiwaꞌi dededenei apo tana parivai-etaꞌetai?
Eyagi pehina, yamna me gaga porana muhomuhohi; ma rava he vaghovaghoi.
Marainana e gogo, yamna e raꞌaraꞌata da ragharaghana e tereterei. Ma kiu ragharaghana au ghoꞌuna he rau-rau numa.”
Yesu, awanaina maghamaghauna ana au dede i rau-guguyei da tauhi hita nota-tuhaghai, ahi nota au ruvana.
Tauhi, awanaꞌineꞌi ava auwarihi ivi haraharamana ma marainana tauna, ana tauvotaghotagho maitehi tauhi ava, yamna awanaina ano ohohina e ririwehi.
Yesu maraꞌapoe ivo vaihubai.
Madeghana tagogina au bigaina, Yesu ana tauvotaghotagho i riwehi ipa, “Tana damana Galili topana au tupoghehauna.”
Tauna au waga i maꞌamaꞌae ma tauhi hi geru da maiteni hi nae. Tauhi, rava boruhi hivo terehi ma hi damana, waga ghehauhi maitehi kampa.
Hive ghaeghaena i towa, yaghina waga i raviravi ma niu waga i howahowai.
Yesu, unuꞌununa au unutana i terei ma waga au murina i enoeno. Ana tauvotaghotagho hi ravi-dagudagui ma hipa, “Tauviharaharamana, tauta tana hiraghe ma tam aiwaꞌi e notanotaꞌi?”
Tauna ivo mahiri ma hive i riwei ipa, “Ma rautautau!” Ma yaghina i riwei ipa, “Ma genuwana!” Hive i wanautuini ma daumora i eno.
Yesu i riwehi ipa, “Aiwaꞌi aubaina o rovorovo? Aiwaꞌi aubaina egha otavi tumaghana?”
Tauhi hi baheꞌi ma hivi tarapiri vivira, “Tauna aiyaꞌi da hive ma yaghina maitehi hivi ponavowehi?”
